name: status-band
description: Clickable status band above the Claude Code prompt: usage limits, cost, context, git, running agents, goal and loops, GPU/CPU/RAM, recent prompts, a memo and your /buddy pet

language.title: Language
language.description: Band, toast and command text language (ko: 한국어, en: English)

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Pill text color: contrast = black or white per pill, whichever reads better on its color; auto follows Claude Code's theme; dark = white text, light = black text

showGit.title: Show git
showGit.description: Branch, ahead/behind and staged/unstaged/untracked counts of the working copy

gitIntervalSec.title: Git interval (s)
gitIntervalSec.description: How often to re-read git status (it is also re-read after edits and shell commands)

showActivity.title: Show activity
showActivity.description: Running subagents and long tools with elapsed time, todo progress, files edited and tool/error counts

showGoalLoop.title: Show goal & loop
showGoalLoop.description: The /goal condition and the scheduled /loop runs (what, and when the next one fires) in their own box above the prompts, only while there is one

pet.title: Pet
pet.description: buddy: your own Claude Code /buddy (rolled from your account, like Claude Code did); a species name: that companion; off: no pet

petName.title: Pet name
petName.description: Shown under the pet (empty: the species name)

petEye.title: Pet eyes
petEye.description: auto: the eyes your buddy rolled

petHat.title: Pet hat
petHat.description: auto: the hat your buddy rolled (common buddies have none)

petPlace.title: Pet place
petPlace.description: auto: under the resource panel when it fits, else beside it; under / beside: only there (no room: no pet)

gpuLocal.description: Poll this machine's GPU (macOS: Apple GPU via ioreg; Linux: nvidia-smi)
gpuLocal.title: Local GPU

gpuSsh.description: Poll the GPU hosts below over ssh
gpuSsh.title: SSH GPU

showCpu.description: Show CPU usage for this machine (and each ssh host when SSH GPU is on)
showCpu.title: Show CPU

showRam.description: Show memory (RAM) usage for this machine (and each ssh host when SSH GPU is on)
showRam.title: Show RAM

gpuColumns.title: Resource columns
gpuColumns.description: auto: two columns when there are more than 4 rows (e.g. 8 GPUs) and they fit; 1 / 2: always

gpuHosts.description: Comma-separated ssh hosts to poll with nvidia-smi (used when SSH GPU is on)
gpuHosts.title: GPU hosts

usageIntervalSec.description: Rate-limit usage fetch interval in seconds
usageIntervalSec.title: Usage interval (s)

promptLines.title: Prompt lines
promptLines.description: How many recent prompts to show

pillColors.title: Palette
pillColors.description: 4 colors #RRGGBB, comma-separated (pink, yellow, green, blue roles): pills, borders, titles

textColor.title: Text color
textColor.description: #RRGGBB for the prompt lines; empty: the terminal's
